name: Cross-sectional intraday momentum basket
hypothesis: Buy leaders and optionally short laggards if predicted edge exceeds turnover cost.
spec: Setup: Rank volatility-adjusted recent returns within a causal universe. Entry: Buy leaders and optionally short laggards if predicted edge exceeds turnover cost. Exit: Exit on rank decay or a fixed rebalance/flat deadline. Parameters to pre-register: lookback, rank_cutoff, beta_neutralization, rebalance_interval.
blocked_reason: needs simultaneous two-leg or basket execution with short legs; the engine trades one instrument per bot
